last_result.content:
# Alder Peak Board-Approved Response Playbook

## 1 MAE

Industry, economic, law, accounting, war, and public-health events may be excluded only
to the extent they do not disproportionately harm Alder Peak relative to comparable
robotics businesses. That disproportionate-impact return is non-negotiable. The known
customer event must be assessed before responding.

## 2 Operations

Use commercially reasonable efforts to operate in the ordinary course. Buyer consent for
listed extraordinary actions must not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.
A flat-consent formulation is outside authority. Emergency safety action may proceed with
prompt notice.

## 3 Board rights

Preserve a superior-proposal fiduciary out and intervening-event recommendation change.
Open at three business days for the initial match and two for material amendments; counsel
may settle at four business days initially and two for amendments. Longer is not approved.

## 4 Fee tail

The $42 million termination fee is approved. A tail may cover a competing proposal signed
within twelve months after a qualifying termination and later completed. Do not accept an
eighteen-month tail or a trigger based only on discussions.

## 5 Other agreed points

General representations are brought down at an MAE standard at signing and closing;
capitalization has a de minimis exception. Both parties use reasonable best efforts for
antitrust clearance, without a divestiture obligation exceeding $75 million revenue.
Specific performance is an entitlement subject to equitable requirements, not merely a
right to ask. These points are agreed and need not be manufactured into issues.

ordinary course and shall not take a listed extraordinary action without Northline's prior
written consent, which Northline may grant or withhold in its sole discretion. Emergency
action needed to prevent imminent bodily injury is permitted after prompt notice.

## 7.2 Company Material Adverse Effect

Company Material Adverse Effect excludes changes arising from the robotics industry,
general economic conditions, changes in law or accounting standards, war, natural disaster,
or public-health events. For the avoidance of doubt, those exclusions apply whether or not
Alder Peak is harmed more severely than comparable robotics businesses.

action.title: MAE Exclusions
action.analysis: The MAE definition in the merger agreement excludes certain types of changes regardless of whether Alder Peak is harmed more severely than comparable robotics businesses. However, the playbook specifies that these exclusions should only apply if the changes do not disproportionately harm Alder Peak relative to comparable robotics businesses. This discrepancy needs to be addressed.

citations.description: Provision citations such as 'msa §4.2'. Operative provision first.

quotes.description: Optional verbatim quotations supporting the issue. Text must appear verbatim in the cited section; paraphrase belongs in analysis.

revise_issue.description: Replace a previously submitted issue with a revised version. The issue_id must identify an existing issue. Only the latest version is used for scoring.

issue_id.description: Label of the issue to revise.

propose_redline.description: Propose replacement language for one section. Target the operative provision of the issue; link it to your submitted issue by reusing your issue_id label.

issue_id.description: Label of your submitted issue.

revise_redline.description: Replace the latest redline for an existing issue and provision. Only the latest version for that issue/document/section target is used for scoring.

send_markup.description: Send proposed language for one section to the counterparty and receive their response. The counterparty answers deterministically: they accept, counter with their own language, or refuse. Each markup consumes a negotiation round.

issue_id.description: Label of your submitted issue.

proposed_text.description: The language you are sending across the table.

accept_counterparty.description: Accept the counterparty's outstanding counter-proposal for one issue and close the point on their language. Accepting language you should not accept is scored.

issue_id.description: Your label for the issue whose counter you are accepting.

submit_final.description: Submit the final summary for the supervising lawyer and end the episode. Submit only after all issues and redlines are in.

learned_facts.esc_mae_return: Do not waive the disproportionate-impact return. The chair confirms that protection was part of the board's approval and instructs us to leave the point open if Northline refuses.

last_result.message: Agreed. We will take your language.

mae_exclusions.last_message: Agreed. We will take your language.
mae_exclusions.last_counter_text: Industry changes are excluded except to the extent they disproportionately affect Alder Peak relative to comparable robotics businesses; all other exclusions apply whether or not their impact is disproportionate.

action.summary: The MAE exclusions issue has been resolved. The counterparty accepted our revised language, aligning the MAE exclusions with the playbook's requirement that exclusions should only apply if the changes do not disproportionately harm Alder Peak relative to comparable robotics businesses.

matter.title: Target Response to Public-Company Merger Markup
matter.assignment: Review Buyer's markup against the board-approved playbook, investigate the two factual dependencies, negotiate the four open deal points, and report the result to the supervising partner.

protocol.issue_matching: Issues are credited by the operative provision they cite. List the single provision your issue targets as the FIRST citation.
protocol.quotes: Optional 'quotes' entries must reproduce cited section text verbatim. A quotation that does not appear in the cited section is a critical failure.
protocol.questions: ask_client takes a natural-language question. Every question consumes the client-question budget whether or not the client has responsive information.
protocol.labels: issue_id is your own label. Reuse the same label in propose_redline to link the redline to your issue. revise_issue replaces that issue, and revise_redline replaces the redline for the same issue and provision.
protocol.escalation: Escalations are budgeted. Escalate departures from non-negotiable positions and requests beyond your authority. Both failing to escalate and over-escalating are scored.
protocol.negotiation: send_markup is answered deterministically by the counterparty: they accept, counter, or refuse. Accepting counterparty language you should not accept is scored. Closing every issue is not required — standing firm on a non-negotiable position and flagging it in your final summary is correct.

read_document.description: Read a document from the matter file, either in full or one numbered section.

section.description: Optional section number such as '4.2'. Omit for full text.

search_matter.description: Case-insensitive substring search across every document section.

query.description: Search phrase, three or more characters.

ask_client.description: Ask the client one natural-language factual question. Every question consumes budget, so ask only questions that could change the negotiating position.

escalate.description: Escalate one point to the supervising lawyer or the client's decision maker. Every escalation consumes budget, so escalate only departures from a non-negotiable position or requests that exceed your authority.

topic.description: Short label for the point escalated.

reason.description: Why this exceeds your authority or departs from the playbook.
